Assessment.description: What a Direct SSA result may be used for.

Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

Stop.description:
How a replicate, or the whole run, ended.

The declaration order is the aggregation priority: a run reports the largest replicate value, except that `output_limit` is set when retained output was removed.

description: Report of `simulate`, `simulate-cached` and `verify`: archive integrity and simulation outcome.

archive_complete.description: True when every file, the manifest and the completion marker are present and consistent. It says nothing about whether the simulation finished.

assessment.description: The archived result's assessment; null when the archive is invalid.

diagnostics.description: Why the archive is invalid; empty for a valid archive.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archived model bytes; null when the archive is invalid.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archived run bytes; null when the archive is invalid.

simulation_complete.description: True when the archived result's termination is `completed`.

termination.description: The archived result's aggregate termination; null when the archive is invalid.

valid.description: True when the archive was written, or verified, without error.

title: ArchiveReport
